item.title: Nanoscale Horizons Emerging Investigator Series: Dr Andrew Meng, University of Missouri, USA
item.description:
Our Emerging Investigator Series highlights exceptional work by early-career nanoscience and nanotechnology researchers. This editorial features an interview with our latest Emerging Investigator, Dr Andrew Meng from University of Missouri, USA.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh90049f

item.description:
Authors: Xiaohui Hu, Yingtong Gao, Qimeng Li, Tao Xu, Litao Sun

The performance of electronic devices based on two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors is critically limited by high contact resistance at metal-semiconductor interfaces. While van der Waals (vdW) contacts mitigate Fermi-level pinning (FLP),...

item.title: Physicochemical properties of CTAB/SDS self-assemblies: impact of mixing intensity and structural hysteresis
item.description:
Authors: Nozomi Morishita Watanabe, Nanaki Kadonishi, Supatcha Suankhem, Ward Wakileh, Yuki Amatsu, Yukihiro Okamoto, Hiroshi Umakoshi

Mixing protocols influence macroscopic phase separation in CTAB/SDS assemblies, while compositional pathways affect dispersion heterogeneity even when measured local membrane properties are comparable.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00149a

item.title: Activatable hypoxia magnetic resonance imaging for early stratification of radiotherapy response
item.description:
Authors: Mingkun Wang, Xiaomin Liu, Guoao Dong, Weilin Chen, Changrong Shi, Xinyi Zhang, Ao Li, Zijian Zhou, Yixi Wang, Hongyi Yang, Fantian Zeng

An activatable hypoxia magnetic resonance imaging (ahMRI) nanoprobe stratifies radiotherapy efficacy by converting hypoxic microenvironment cues into distance-dependent T 1 MRI signals for non-invasive treatment prediction.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00371k

item.title: Engineering NGQD@4CzIPN nanorods for efficient photoredox BNAH regeneration and Biginelli cyclocondensation under visible light
item.description:
Authors: Geeta Srivastava, Rajesh K. Yadav, Shaifali Mishra, Kanchan Sharma, Mohit, Surendra K. Jaiswal, Anupma Yadav, Rahul Maddheshiya, Kamlesh Kumar, Jin-OoK Baeg

Metal-free NGQD@4CzIPN nanorods enable efficient visible-light-driven BNAH regeneration (58.97%) and Biginelli synthesis of DHMPs in up to 91% yield, demonstrating their potential for sustainable cofactor regeneration and organic synthesis.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00283h
